capabilities.name: Complaint and refund request handling
capabilities.summary: A customer complains or asks for money back, and whoever handles it gets your policy's answer: the order matched, each condition checked, the amount worked out, any refund set out for a named person to approve, and a reply ready to edit and send.

capabilities.name: Customer reply drafting
capabilities.summary: Every customer gets the reply your best person would write. Hand over the customer's message, your tone guide and your approved answers, and get back a draft in your voice where every statement and every promise traces to something you approved. A person on your team reads it, edits it and sends it.

capabilities.name: Help article from a resolved issue
capabilities.summary: Turn every answer your team works out once into an article the next customer finds on their own. Hand over a resolved ticket and your list of articles; get back a draft in your customers' words, with their details removed and every step traced to the ticket. Your knowledge-base owner decides what goes live.

capabilities.name: Support service level definition
capabilities.summary: The support lead gets reply and resolution targets for every priority level, worked out from the team's own ticket history and the hours the team really has. Each target shows how often the team already meets it, and every gap comes back as a question for the lead to settle.

capabilities.name: Support ticket triage
capabilities.summary: Your queue manager opens the morning’s tickets already sorted: each one with a category, a priority and a route, and the reason for all three in a line. The tickets that cannot wait sit at the top, stopped for a person to decide.
